# Visual-search photograph fixtures

19 reduced-size JPEG copies of existing publicly displayed Zefanya catalog photos, captured locally on November 17, 2026. `manifest.json` maps fixture files to test-only product/category identifiers and public listing labels. No customer, account, order, private document or credential data is included. Fixtures are not replacements for the original reported book-stack screenshot, which was unavailable.

Tests derive moderate lighting/background-padding variations from these actual photos. They demonstrate conservative retrieval of the same photographed items, not semantic recognition of unseen objects. Production ranking contains no fixture IDs, category labels or product titles.
